in_sanskrit.name: Patani
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lotus Lake
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Patani एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Patani is derived from the Sanskrit word Patan, which means 'lotus'. The name is also associated with the image of a lake surrounded by lotus flowers. This name is often given to girls born in the Hindu tradition who are believed to embody the beauty and grace of the lotus flower, as well as the strength and resilience of the lake.
